metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 `ical` CLI in `output/` (no third-party deps) with:

- `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`: Parses/unfolds `.ics`, builds component trees, decodes VCALENDAR/VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY(+AVAILABLE)/VALARM into the required JSON top-level schema, preserves `raw_properties`, and emits warnings (including iTIP `METHOD` checks).
- `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`: Expands VEVENT recurrences (RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE, basic EXRULE support w/ warning), applies RECURRENCE-ID overrides (incl. `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE` best-effort), resolves TZID via in-file VTIMEZONE to UTC (with fold/gap warnings), and outputs sorted `occurrences` plus `warnings`.

Build/run:
- `cmake -B build -S output && cmake --build build`
- Executable: `output/build/ical`
